Website Development Services in Saudi Arabia

Every business has unique needs, which is why we offer a complete range of website development services tailored to the Saudi market. Our approach goes beyond basic website design to create digital platforms that support your business operations and growth objectives.

When off-the-shelf solutions fall short, our custom web development services in Saudi Arabia deliver exactly what your business needs. We build bespoke platforms from the ground up, designed specifically for your workflows, customer interactions, and business processes. This is particularly valuable for companies with specialised requirements that standard templates cannot accommodate.

Our custom development work includes integration with your existing systems, whether that is your ERP, CRM, or inventory management software. We have extensive experience building web applications that connect seamlessly with enterprise tools used across Saudi businesses.
Learn more about custom web development services in Saudi Arabia

WordPress powers a significant portion of websites globally, and for good reason. Our WordPress website development agency in Saudi Arabia specialises in creating sites that are easy to manage, search engine-friendly, and fully customised to your brand identity.

We develop custom WordPress themes rather than relying on generic templates. This means your website looks unique and includes features designed specifically for your business. From multilingual Arabic and English sites to complex membership portals, our WordPress expertise covers the full spectrum.
Explore our WordPress website development agency

The e-commerce market in Saudi Arabia is experiencing rapid growth, and businesses need robust online stores to compete. Our e-commerce website development services in Saudi Arabia focus on creating shopping experiences that convert visitors into customers.

We work with platforms including WooCommerce, Shopify, and Magento, selecting the right solution based on your product catalogue size, budget, and technical requirements. Every e-commerce website we build includes integration with local payment gateways like Mada, STC Pay, and Tabby, ensuring smooth transactions for Saudi customers.
Security is paramount in online retail. We implement SSL certificates, PCI-DSS compliance measures, and secure checkout processes that protect both your business and your customers.

Progressive Web Apps represent the future of mobile web experiences. These applications work like native mobile apps but run through web browsers, eliminating the need for app store downloads. Our PWA development services give Saudi businesses the best of both worlds: the reach of websites with the functionality of mobile applications.

PWAs load instantly, work offline, and send push notifications to users. For businesses targeting mobile-first Saudi consumers, this technology delivers exceptional user experiences while reducing development costs compared to building separate native apps.
Learn about Progressive Web Apps for Saudi businesses

Modern businesses operate across multiple locations and need centralised platforms for their teams, customers, and vendors. Our cloud-based portal development services in Saudi Arabia create secure, scalable platforms that bring your business operations together.

We build customer portals that allow clients to access account information, place orders, and track services. Employee portals centralise HR functions, internal communications, and document management. Vendor portals streamline procurement and supplier relationships. Each portal is designed with role-based access controls and secure authentication.

A website that goes without regular upkeep quickly becomes a liability rather than an asset. Our website maintenance services in Saudi Arabia keep your digital presence secure, fast, and fully functional long after launch day. We monitor your site continuously, applying security patches, updating plugins and frameworks, and resolving technical issues before they affect your visitors or your search rankings.

Maintenance packages include performance optimisation, regular backups, uptime monitoring, and content updates as your business evolves. We ensure your website continues to meet the latest web standards and remains compatible with new browsers and devices, protecting both your investment and your online reputation.
Learn about website maintenance services in Saudi Arabia
Why Saudi Businesses Choose Nalk Solutions
We help companies align their web presence with Saudi Arabia's digital transformation goals and the knowledge-based economy envisioned in Vision 2030.
Proper RTL support for Arabic and English. Our team includes Arabic specialists who ensure your copy sounds natural to Saudi readers.
Built-in e-invoicing integration from the start. We ensure your platform generates compliant invoices and maintains proper records.
Integration with Mada, STC Pay, Tabby, and Tamara. We handle the technical complexity of local payment gateways for Saudi consumers.
Designing for the 90%+ smartphone penetration in Saudi Arabia. We ensure the best experience for mobile users and better search rankings.
Our structured six-step process ensures clear communication, on-time delivery, and websites that meet your objectives.

Every successful website starts with thorough planning. We begin by learning about your business, your target customers, and your specific goals for the website. We deliver a detailed project plan that outlines deliverables, timelines, and milestones.

Our designers create wireframes and high-fidelity mockups. This includes colour schemes aligned with your brand identity, typography, and imagery. For bilingual sites, we create separate designs for Arabic and English versions.
We build the functional website using modern frameworks like React, Vue.js, and Laravel. We connect your website to existing tools like ERP, CRM, and marketing automation platforms.
Rigorous testing across functionality, performance, and security. We confirm cross-browser compatibility and cross-device display, including complete transaction testing for e-commerce sites.
Deploying to your hosting environment with SSL, domain configuration, and performance optimization. We monitor the site closely post-launch and perform initial SEO setup.
Applying security patches, updating plugins, monitoring uptime, and making content updates. Our maintenance packages are flexible to fit your specific technical needs.

Serving Major Cities Across Saudi Arabia
Our website development services extend throughout the Kingdom, with particular focus on the major business centers where most Saudi companies operate.

As Saudi Arabia’s capital and largest city, Riyadh hosts the headquarters of major corporations and growing startups. Our Riyadh web development services address the sophisticated needs of businesses in this dynamic market.
Learn more about web development in Riyadh
Jeddah’s position as Saudi Arabia’s commercial hub and gateway to the Red Sea creates unique opportunities. We support the city’s diverse community from logistics to retail enterprises.
Dammam and the wider Eastern Province drive Saudi Arabia’s energy and industrial sectors. Companies in this region often need sophisticated web applications and portals.
What is the typical cost of website development in Saudi Arabia?

Website development costs vary based on complexity, features, and design requirements. A basic business website with 5 to 8 pages typically ranges from SAR 8,000 to SAR 15,000. E-commerce websites start around SAR 15,000 for small catalogues and can reach SAR 50,000 or more for comprehensive online stores with hundreds of products. Custom web applications are quoted based on specific requirements, generally starting from SAR 25,000. We provide detailed quotes after understanding your needs during the discovery phase.
How long does it take to develop a website?

Timeline depends on project scope. A standard business website takes approximately 6 to 8 weeks from kickoff to launch. This includes design, development, content creation, and testing. E-commerce websites typically require 10 to 14 weeks due to additional complexity in product setup, payment integration, and checkout process development. Custom web applications can take 3 to 6 months, depending on features and integrations. We provide a detailed timeline in our project proposal.
Do you provide website hosting and domain registration?

Yes, we offer complete website hosting solutions optimised for performance and security. Our hosting packages include SSL certificates, daily backups, security monitoring, and technical support. We can also handle domain registration for your business or work with your existing domain name. For businesses with specific hosting requirements, we can deploy your website to your preferred hosting provider.
Can you integrate our website with ZATCA for e-invoicing compliance?

Absolutely. ZATCA compliance is essential for businesses operating in Saudi Arabia. We build ecommerce platforms and business portals with ZATCA e-invoicing integration from the start. This includes generating compliant invoices, maintaining proper records, and connecting to approved e-invoicing solutions. Our developers stay current with Saudi tax authority requirements to ensure your website remains compliant as regulations evolve.
Will our website support both Arabic and English?

Yes, we specialise in bilingual website development for the Saudi market. Our websites include proper right-to-left support for Arabic content, appropriate Arabic font selection, and layout adjustments that ensure both languages are presented optimally. We can also develop content in Arabic or work with your existing Arabic copy, ensuring natural language that resonates with Saudi audiences.
What payment gateways do you integrate for Saudi customers?

We integrate all major payment options used in Saudi Arabia. This includes Mada for local debit card payments, STC Pay for mobile wallet transactions, Tabby and Tamara for buy-now-pay-later options, and international card processors like Visa and Mastercard. We handle the technical integration, security requirements, and testing to ensure smooth payment processing.
Do you offer ongoing support after the website launches?

Yes, ongoing support is essential for maintaining website performance and security. Our maintenance packages include security updates, plugin and framework updates, content changes, performance monitoring, backup management, and technical support. We offer different levels of support based on your needs, from basic monthly maintenance to comprehensive managed services.
Can you redesign our existing website?

We provide complete website redesign services for businesses whose current sites no longer meet their needs. Our redesign process includes analysis of your current website, identification of performance and user experience issues, development of improved design and functionality, content migration to the new platform, and URL structure preservation to maintain search rankings. We ensure your new website performs better while retaining the SEO value of your existing site.
What industries do you have experience working with?

We have developed websites for businesses across multiple sectors in Saudi Arabia. Our experience includes healthcare and medical facilities, educational institutions and e-learning platforms, real estate developers and agencies, hospitality and tourism businesses, retail and e-commerce companies, professional services firms, government and municipal entities, and manufacturing and industrial companies. This diverse experience allows us to understand industry-specific requirements and create websites that address sector challenges.
How do you ensure our website ranks well in search engines?

SEO is built into our development process from the start. We implement clean, search-engine-friendly code, optimise page load speeds, create mobile-responsive designs, implement proper heading structure and meta tags, generate XML sitemaps, and set up Google Analytics and Search Console. For businesses targeting local customers, we optimise for local search by including location information, creating location-specific content, and implementing local business schema markup. Ongoing SEO requires content updates and link building, which we can handle through our digital marketing services.
Can you help with content creation for our website?

Yes, we offer content development services for both Arabic and English websites. Our content team includes writers who understand Saudi business culture and can create copy that resonates with local audiences. This includes service descriptions, product information, blog articles, and other website content. We work with you to understand your brand voice and messaging, then develop content that communicates effectively with your target customers.
What happens if we need changes after the website launches?

Websites evolve with your business, and we expect you will need updates over time. Minor changes are typically included in maintenance packages. Larger updates like new page sections, additional features, or design changes are quoted separately. We maintain detailed documentation of your website’s architecture, making it straightforward to implement changes efficiently. Our ongoing relationship means we understand your site and can respond quickly to update requests.

Your business deserves a website that works as hard as you do. Whether you need a professional business website, a comprehensive e-commerce platform, or a custom web application, Nalk Solutions has the expertise to bring your vision to life.

We serve businesses throughout Saudi Arabia, from Riyadh to Jeddah to Dammam and beyond. Our team understands the local market, regulatory requirements, and cultural considerations that make websites successful in the Kingdom.
Contact us today for a free consultation.
Share your project requirements, and we will provide a detailed proposal with a timeline and investment required. Let’s build something great together.
